plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: Manual-only interrogatives for work in progress: /why /where /what /how /who /when. Claims carry checkable provenance instead of a confidence score, and nothing here writes.

plugins.name: dialect
plugins.description: Manual-only controlled-language modes. Constrains the vocabulary, sentence shape, and order of what Claude writes to a published rule set, for one target or for the rest of the session. Ships /ste (ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English), /ubiquitous (domain-driven design's ubiquitous language), and /bluf (bottom line up front).
